description: Turn one product photo into a creator-style video ad for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts. Skip a studio shoot, test new hooks, and add final copy after download.
h1: AI UGC Video Ads for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts
lead: If you have one product photo, you have what you need to start a UGC video ad. Create a creator-style clip for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts without booking a shoot.

steps.d: Add one photo that shows the full product. The product stays visible in the finished scene.
Give one scene and one action in a sentence. A focused action keeps the ad easy to follow.
Download the clip and add captions, prices, or music in your editor. Your clean master stays ready for each channel.

faq.q: What does an AI UGC video ad show?
faq.a: It shows your product in a creator-style scene with a short spoken line or visible action. The presenter and setting are AI-generated.

faq.q: Do I need a model or a creator?
faq.a: No. The presenter is AI-generated, so you can make the scene without booking a creator or studio.

faq.q: Can I run these videos as paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Download the clip, add any required disclosure and campaign text, then review it against the platform rules before launch.

faq.q: Can I add captions, prices, or music?
faq.a: Yes. Add exact text and licensed music after download in TikTok, CapCut, or your ad editor.

faq.q: Can I make a product demonstration ad?
faq.a: Yes. A visible product action can explain one feature while the presenter keeps the product in view.

faq.q: Which video lengths can I choose?
faq.a: Available lengths are 6, 10, 15, and 30 seconds. Pick the length that gives one action a clear beginning and end.

faq.q: How many credits does a video ad cost?
faq.a: The editor shows the credit cost before you generate. Current examples are 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10 seconds, and 60 for 15 seconds; 30-second pricing is shown in the editor.

faq.q: Can I present an AI-generated person as a real customer?
faq.a: No. The presenter is not a real customer or endorsement. Use a brand explanation or an approved customer quote and disclose AI use where required.

cards.label: Skincare Products
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. At a bright vanity, an adult woman applies one pass of tinted lip balm and says: “A quick tint before I head out.” She lowers the balm and pauses facing the lens. Soft morning window light, natural skin texture, casual GRWM ad look. Chest-up mirror framing with one gentle push-in. End facing the mirror with the lip balm tube beside her lips. Sound: her voice and cap click; no music.
